content:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Observed sudden p99 latency spike on inference gateway (control-plane deps). Trigger: p99 > 2.0s for > 3min. Paging oncall.
Sophie: I'm seeing streaming stalls reported from multiple regions, p95 jumped too. Tentative root: config fetch/auth latency.
Raj: Confirmed. Traces show config-fetch RPCs to configstore spiking with 504s and retries. Auth token service also shows increased 5xx.
Leah (oncall): I'm on it, joining now. How bad is customer impact? Any throttles firing?
Sophie: Some customers report timeouts on streaming sessions. Route-level errors up ~2.3% (baseline 0.1%). Token-store KPS dropped, rate-limit backpressure visible in gateway logs.
Tim: Adding logs: 
```
[2026-03-14T21:14:02Z] gateway: req_id=abcd1234 route=/v1/streams model=redwood-004 duration=3456ms err=upstream_timeout
[2026-03-14T21:14:03Z] configstore: fetch key=feature_flags/xxx latency=1200ms status=504
[2026-03-14T21:14:03Z] auth: token-validate latency=900ms status=500
```
Raj: Quick query I ran against metrics: 
```
SELECT percentile_latency, count(*) FROM request_stats WHERE route LIKE '/v1/streams' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';
-- p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 3.4s, errors 2.3%
```
Leah (oncall): Thanks. Immediate mitigation options: 1) Route streaming routes to fallback control-plane (read-only cache) 2) Short-circuit config fetch for known stable feature flags 3) Increase configstore replicas / surge capacity. Which one do we prefer to do fast?
Sophie: Option 1 + 2 are fastest. We have a known fallback variant for streams in prod. We can flip routing in ~2min via canary route.
Tim: I'll prepare the canary route commands. 
```
# toggle canary routing for streams
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://controlplane/api/routes/canary -d '{"route":"/v1/streams","target":"fallback-model","percent":100}'
```
InfraBot: [automation] Canaries are gated by safety check: configstore must be readable. Current check failing (504). Manual override required.
Leah (oncall): Aha. So we need a manual fallback change. Sophie, can you patch the gateway env var to prefer cached config first? That bypasses the failing fetch.
Sophie: On it. Pushing patch to gateway deploy-least: `GATEWAY_CONFIG_MODE=cached-first` then roll one pod. Rolling now.
Amanda: I'll open a configstore incident to scale replicas and check underlying DB connections. Adding DRI: infra-db.
Raj: Note: There's also spike in feature flag evaluation latency. If we short-circuit featureflag checks for streaming routes to safe/defaults that should reduce the auth/config chattiness.
Leah (oncall): Agreed. Sophie, after patch, please verify p95/p99 and error rate. If not improving in 5min escalate to full traffic diversion to stateless fallback.
Sophie: Patch rolled to 1 pod. Observability showing initial improvement on that pod: stream success up, errors down from 2.3% -> 1.1% in that pod. Rolling remainder now.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0314-37. Severity: sev2. Impact: degraded streaming for subset of customers, possible SLO breach for p99.
Tim: Rolling complete across gateway fleet. Beginning short-circuit of featureflag evals for streams. Command: `rbac set feature_flags.stream_eval_mode=forced_default --env=prod`
Sophie: Featureflag override applied. Metrics: p95 ~ 180ms, p99 ~ 1.1s, errors ~0.4% (down from 2.3%).
Leah (oncall): Good. Customer impact reduced. Still seeing occasional tail spikes ~1.2s. Need to continue monitoring. Amanda, infra action items?
Amanda: Spinning up 2 additional configstore replicas and checking DB connection pool. Also increasing token-store rate window to reduce 429s while we stabilize.
Raj: Will instrument an additional trace sample for heavy tails and run flamegraph on configstore.
Leah (oncall): Handoff plan: I'll keep monitoring for 30m then hand to night oncall if stable. Please add notes to INC-2026-0314-37 with the mitigation steps and customer list.
Sophie: Adding note: Mitigations applied — gateway cached-first, featureflag forced default for streams, configstore replicas scaled, token-store window increased.
Tim: Also enabling temporary routing fallback for a couple high-traffic customers as safety net (manual opt-in).
Leah (oncall): Thanks team. Next steps: 1) postmortem if incident persists >1h 2) root-cause RCA with configstore infra and auth teams 3) consider circuit-breaker for config-fetch in gateway.
incidents-bot: @pager-duty paging Leah (oncall) to confirm handoff in 20m.
Sophie: Customer impact currently reduced to low-medium. No major customer escalations yet. Monitoring closely.
Amanda: Created infra ticket: INFRA-4821 to follow up on DB pool tuning and autoscale thresholds.
Raj: I'll start a deeper dive and share traces in the incident doc.
Leah (oncall): If things re-regress ping me directly, I'll re-open routing fallback. Handoff to night oncall @alex scheduled at 3067891399.
Alex (next-oncall): ack, I'll take over if still degraded.
Sophie: Fingers crossed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
